This significant growth is primarily driven by Amazon Web Services (AWS), which saw a 37% year-over-year increase in Q2 FY2026 revenue to $42.23 billion and is expected to accelerate further with major AI compute contracts. Amazon's substantial investments in AI infrastructure, custom chips, and robotics are key factors supporting this ambitious profit projection.

events.title: The FCC Mulls Banning China-Sourced Optical Transceivers, Threatening Innolight’s 27% Global Market Share As Coherent And Lumentum Prepare To Pounce
events.summary: The FCC is considering banning China-sourced optical transceivers, which could significantly impact China's Zhongji Innolight, a company holding 27% of the global market share with over 90% of its revenue from outside China. This move could boost US manufacturers like Coherent Corp. and Lumentum, though an immediate full ban seems unlikely due to Innolight's dominance and compatibility issues. The FCC may instead focus on banning upgrades to next-gen transceivers to allow US companies to ramp up production, as part of a broader strategy to de-risk critical supply chains.

events.title: The Case Against the Proposed Chip Security Act in Taiwan
events.summary: Taiwan's main opposition party, the Kuomintang (KMT), is proposing legislation that would require legislative approval for certain outbound investments by Taiwanese semiconductor companies. This article argues against this proposal, citing concerns about the constitutional allocation of powers, administrative due process, and the blurring of the relationship between the government and the governed. It suggests that while the legislature has a role in shaping economic security policy, direct involvement in individual investment decisions is institutionally ill-suited for a legislative body.

This move is driven by extreme demand for AI chips that current suppliers like Nvidia and AMD cannot fully satisfy, despite ramping up production. Anthropic emphasizes this is part of a multi-chip strategy to gain flexibility and optimize workloads, rather than replacing existing hardware partnerships, signaling a bullish outlook for the entire AI semiconductor ecosystem.

events.summary: Himax Technologies (NASDAQ:HIMX), a semiconductor maker, is scheduled to report earnings this Thursday. events.title: SPCQ +21% and NVDL + 6% as SpaceX Earnings Reshuffle the AI Chip Trade
events.summary: SpaceX's recent earnings report, which highlighted significant AI capital spending, has reshuffled the AI chip market. NVIDIA was named the exclusive AI chip supplier for SpaceX's Starmind project, causing GraniteShares 2x Long NVDA Daily ETF (NVDL) to rise by 6.6%, while Defiance Daily Target 2X Short SpaceX ETF (SPCQ) surged 21% due to investor concerns over SpaceX's capital expenditure and dilution risks. AMD, despite reporting record revenue and doubled data center sales, saw its stock drop 6.94% after losing the Starmind chip socket to NVIDIA.

events.title: Qualcomm Inc Stock (QCOM) Moved Down by 3.31% on Aug 5: Key Drivers Unveiled
events.summary: Qualcomm Inc (QCOM) stock declined by 3.31% on August 5, primarily due to cooling global discretionary spending, macroeconomic headwinds, and sector-specific concerns. These concerns include the transition of major handset manufacturers to in-house modem solutions and intensifying competition in the mid-to-high-tier smartphone market. Technical indicators show a MACD sell signal, while media coverage and market sentiment are neutral.

events.title: EPAM Systems earnings up next: Large deal pipeline in focus
events.summary: EPAM Systems is set to release its second-quarter results, with analysts expecting modest sequential improvement. Investors will be closely watching for progress on its growing pipeline of large deals and how its strategic AI partnerships translate into revenue growth or margin expansion. Despite recent AI-related recognition and partnerships, the company's stock trades at a forward P/E ratio suggesting limited near-term growth, which the upcoming report will test.

events.title: Nvidia stock rises after Musk says SpaceX will exclusively use company's chips
events.summary: Nvidia's stock saw a significant rise after Elon Musk announced that SpaceX will exclusively use Nvidia's AI systems for its services, highlighting a strong partnership between the two companies. SpaceX plans to build substantial computing capacity, including launching Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 rackscale system both on Earth and in space as part of its Starmind satellite program. This move comes as SpaceX reported a substantial increase in AI revenues, driven by cloud service agreements and subscriptions.

events.title: Tech travel drives 41% gain at Sunnyvale hotels

events.title: Viavi Solutions faces earnings test as AI data center boom continues

Investors will be closely watching the sustainability of AI-driven demand, the integration of the Spirent acquisition, and the company's path to GAAP profitability. Despite trading below its 52-week high, analysts remain bullish, with a consensus price target implying significant upside.

events.title: Innoviz Technologies Ltd. Q2 2026 Earnings Call Summary
events.summary: Innoviz Technologies reported record Q2 2026 revenue of $18.1 million, driven by automotive milestones and defense contract wins, showcasing a pivot to diversified revenue streams. The company is strategically expanding into defense and homeland security with its new 'Perciz' brand, aiming for defense sales to reach 30% of total revenue by 2027. Innoviz reiterated its 2026 revenue guidance of $67 million to $73 million, expecting positive gross margins and operational runway into 2028.

events.title: CDW Corporation Q2 2026 Earnings Call Summary
events.summary: CDW Corporation reported record net sales and EPS in Q2 2026, driven by strong demand for AI readiness and infrastructure modernization, particularly within large enterprise and government segments. The company's diversified portfolio and strategic focus on AI are expected to fuel continued growth, with full-year 2026 U.S. IT market growth projected in the mid-single digits. Despite gross margin compression due to product mix, CDW maintains confidence in its business model, as evidenced by a $1 billion share repurchase authorization and plans for operational savings through its 'Geared for Growth' initiative.

events.title: IES Holdings executive chairman Gendell sells $31.9m common stock
events.summary: Jeffrey L. Gendell, Executive Chairman of IES Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:IESC), recently sold 47,156 shares of the company's common stock for approximately $31.9 million. These transactions, occurring between May 6 and May 8, 2026, took place near the stock's 52-week high, despite InvestingPro suggesting the stock is overvalued. The sales were reported in an SEC filing and involved shares directly held by Mr. Gendell, though he and affiliated Tontine entities retain significant holdings.

events.title: Micron (MU) Has More to Gain Than Nvidia (NVDA) Has to Lose From Samsung’s 2028 Warning
events.summary: Samsung's warning about potential memory shortages through 2028 is seen as a significant positive for Micron Technology, strengthening its pricing outlook and leading to a stock jump. While it poses a potential supply constraint for Nvidia, the impact is less severe due to Nvidia's diversified supplier base. Micron has already secured long-term agreements with customers, providing pricing stability, while Nvidia's challenge lies more in deployment timing than demand.

events.title: Broadcom, Nvidia Face Risk From China AI Component Ban - Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO), Advanced Micro Devices
events.summary: A proposed U.S. ban on Chinese-made optical transceivers, critical for AI infrastructure, could negatively impact U.S. tech giants like Broadcom, Nvidia, and Advanced Micro Devices. BNP Paribas analyst Karl Ackerman warns that such a ban could disrupt the highly interconnected supply chain, leading to increased costs and potential bottlenecks in AI development. Chinese manufacturers currently dominate the optical transceiver market, and replacing their capacity would be challenging, potentially hindering the deployment of next-generation AI infrastructure.

events.title: RB Global, Inc. Q2 2026 Earnings Call Summary
events.summary: RB Global, Inc. reported an 11% GTV growth in Q2 2026, driven by marketplace performance and the BigIron acquisition, and expanded its automotive segment with a significant partnership. The company raised its 2026 GTV growth outlook to 9% to 11% and committed to adjusted EBITDA growth exceeding service revenue growth, while also increasing its quarterly common stock dividend by 6.5% to $0.33 per share. Management addressed questions regarding the sustainability of margins after the BigIron integration, competitive dynamics, and the strategic rationale for inventory purchases.

events.title: SK Telecom Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
events.summary: SK Telecom reported strong Q2 2026 earnings with operating profit up 67.3% year-over-year and AI data center revenue growing 92.5%, largely due to the Pangyo facility and new Seoul data center construction. The company announced the establishment of SK Hyper, a dedicated subsidiary, to develop AI data center projects and expand capacity to 5GW, aiming to secure land, power, and customers while balancing growth investment with stable shareholder returns through external funding. Management emphasized that AI infrastructure demand is a structural trend and Korea has a competitive edge in meeting global tech companies' needs.

events.title: Non-U.S. Tech Growth Outpaces U.S., Thornburg Says
events.summary: International technology companies are projected to achieve faster earnings growth than their U.S. counterparts through 2028, with non-U.S. tech earnings potentially growing 58% annually versus 35% for U.S. tech. Thornburg Investment Management attributes this gap to U.S. hyperscalers spending heavily on AI infrastructure, leading to significant debt, while international tech benefits from shifting supply chains and less AI-related debt. The Thornburg International Growth ETF (TXUG) focuses on non-U.S. companies with strong earnings growth without the high debt burden.

events.title: Celldex Therapeutics stock hits 52-week high at $40.30

events.title: Avnet, Inc. Q4 2026 Earnings Call Summary

events.title: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM) Stock Looks Fully Priced After Its 356% Run

events.title: How MP Materials (NYSE:MP) Connects to the Electrification Wave?
events.summary: MP Materials (NYSE:MP) is gaining attention due to the rising demand for metals essential in electric vehicles, data centers, and power grids, linking the company directly to the broad electrification trend. The company produces rare earth materials used in high-performance magnets and is expanding into magnet production itself. Rare earth materials are crucial for electric motors, generators, and electronic devices, making them vital for advancing electrified transportation, computing, and power infrastructure.

events.title: Palomar Holdings, Inc. Q2 2026 Earnings Call Summary
events.summary: Palomar Holdings, Inc. reported record adjusted net income in Q2 2026, driven by a diversified portfolio, strong residential earthquake retention, and significant casualty growth. This allows investors to mitigate losses during Bitcoin downturns and get paid to wait for a recovery, though it caps some of the potential upside during sharp rallies.

Muse Code acts as an orchestrator, using background agents to plan, write, and validate code changes in parallel, logging all actions and ensuring the working copy remains untouched.

events.title: Hock Tan Reaffirmed Broadcom's $100 Billion AI Forecast. Six Customers Carry Nearly All of It.
